description: You are an online store administrator for Urban Electronics, a Drupal Commerce store. A customer named Jane Smith (username: janesmith) has called in requesting to place an order. Create an order for her containing the following items: 1x Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Headphones ($348.00) and 1x Logitech MX Master 3S Wireless Mouse ($99.99). Apply the coupon code WELCOME10 to the order for a 10% discount. The order must have a billing address set (use: Jane Smith, 789 Oak Avenue, Portland, OR 97201, US). Finally, place the order so its state is no longer 'draft'. The Drupal admin credentials are admin / Admin1234! and the site is at http://localhost.
